# Two splits: one on a liability account, the other on an expense account.
# `Liabilities:Credit Card USD` −113.00 against `Expenses:Supplies:USD`
# +113.00.
#
# The whole payment recorded as one expense, tax and all, which is what a
# bookkeeper writes before the bill exists — there is nothing yet to say how
# much of it was tax.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction, neither split in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies:USD
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Credit Card USD
	type: Credit Card
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Tax
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Tax:GST USD
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-02-16 * "Paid the supplier gross on the card"
	guid: "99aabbccddeeff00112233445566778a"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Expenses:Supplies:USD 113.00 USD
		guid: "aabbccddeeff00112233445566778a99"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Liabilities:Credit Card USD -113.00 USD
		guid: "bbccddeeff00112233445566778a99aa"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
